title: BizApp365 Support
metaDescription: Get help with the BizApp365 app on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web. Contact support by email, phone or WhatsApp, and find answers to common questions.
intro: Need help with BizApp365 on iPhone, iPad, Android or the web? Our team is here to help with sign-in, setup, syncing, printing and anything else you need.
Email sales@bizapp365.com, call +971 58 288 5633, or message us on WhatsApp. We reply within one business day (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00–18:00 Gulf Standard Time).

sections.title: Contact support
paragraphsAfter: To help us resolve your issue quickly, please include your company / tenant name, the email you sign in with, your device model and app version, and a short description or screenshot of the problem. Never send us your password.

sections.title: I can't sign in
bullets: Check that you are using the email and password provided by your company administrator.
Make sure your device is connected to the internet and the date and time are set automatically.
If your password was reset or your account was disabled, ask your company administrator, or contact us with your company name.

sections.title: My data isn't up to date
bullets: BizApp365 works on one real-time ledger. Pull down to refresh, or close and reopen the app.
If you were offline, reconnect and wait a moment for pending transactions to sync.
If figures still differ from the web app, contact support with the document number and time.

sections.title: Printing and sharing invoices
bullets: Invoices and receipts can be shared as PDF from the document screen using the share button.
For Bluetooth or network printers, make sure the printer is on, paired and selected in the app settings.
Contact us if your printer model is not listed — we can help with setup.

sections.title: Account, privacy and deletion
paragraphs: Accounts are created by your company administrator. To learn how we handle your data, or to request deletion of your account and personal data, use the links below.

sections.title: New to BizApp365?
paragraphs: BizApp365 is a complete ERP for SMEs in the UAE and Oman — accounting, inventory, sales, CRM, service center, HR/payroll and van sales. Book a free demo and we'll set up your company for you.
